purpose: Accountant-ready, entity-isolated bookkeeping records for every Fleet Core member and the Captain and Admiral offices.

boundaries.correction_model: append-only reversal or adjustment; never silent replacement

authority_rules.captain: May record Captain-authorized fleet operating entries and the Captain office book.
authority_rules.admiral: May record Admiral-authorized fleet governance and commissioning entries, including Admiral programs.
authority_rules.fleet_member: May record entries only for an exact project membership.
authority_rules.system: May import only through a separately authenticated server process; not by browser role assertion.

retention.supporting_documents: retain outside this browser ledger under the accountant-approved retention policy
retention.exports: UTF-8 CSV with one row per retained entry

write_integrity.success_condition: exact payload written and exactly one new entry read back by entry_id and submission_id
write_integrity.duplicate_prevention: one active submission token per completed form; repeated or delayed save events cannot create a second transaction
write_integrity.attention_count: one count per transaction needing review or a receipt; multiple reasons never count the same transaction twice
write_integrity.quota_recovery: compact duplicate derived authority-audit evidence, then retry once
write_integrity.failure_behavior: retain the completed form and state that no ledger record was created
